symbols.name: last-place unit
symbols.meaning: The size $2^{-p}$ of one unit in the last place of a value with $p$ fractional bits.
symbols.quote: Write $h_p=2^{-p}$ for the size of one unit in the last place: a value with $p$ fractional bits is a multiple of $h_p$, and an error of $a$ units is an absolute error below $a\,h_p$.

symbols.name: nearest integer
symbols.meaning: The integer nearest to a computed value that lies within $1/2$ of it.
symbols.quote: So if a computed value is within $1/2$ of an integer $m$, then $m$ is the unique nearest integer and rounding returns $m$.

symbols.name: bilinear map
symbols.meaning: The bilinear map whose approximate products are bounded.
symbols.quote: This analysis handles each product as a [bilinear map](bilinear-map.md) $\mathcal{B}$ of approximate operands $f'$ and $g'$, which approximate $f$ and $g$.

symbols.name: approximate first operand
symbols.meaning: The computed approximation of the first operand $f$.
symbols.quote: This analysis handles each product as a [bilinear map](bilinear-map.md) $\mathcal{B}$ of approximate operands $f'$ and $g'$, which approximate $f$ and $g$.

symbols.name: approximate second operand
symbols.meaning: The computed approximation of the second operand $g$.
symbols.quote: This analysis handles each product as a [bilinear map](bilinear-map.md) $\mathcal{B}$ of approximate operands $f'$ and $g'$, which approximate $f$ and $g$.

symbols.name: source-transform error
symbols.meaning: The error bound, in units of $h_p$, of each source transform, equal to $9\cdot2^\gamma T\log_2T$.
symbols.quote: Each source transform has error $E_s=9\cdot2^\gamma T\log_2T$ units, where $E_s$ is measured in units of $h_p$.

symbols.name: ring-stage error
symbols.meaning: The error bound, in units of $h_p$, of the polynomial-ring convolution stage.
symbols.quote: So the ring stage error is $E_{\rm ring}=\frac{T}{r}(3\log_2 T+2)$ units, and since $r\ge1$ and $\log_2T\ge1$, $E_{\rm ring}<5T\log_2 T$.

symbols.name: scaled product error
symbols.meaning: The error bound, in units of $h_p$, of the first scaled product $\tilde\varpi$.
symbols.quote: Multiplying by $S$ gives $\tilde\varpi$, which approximates $\varpi$ with error $E_{\varpi}=S(3E_s+2)$ units.

symbols.name: computed digit convolution
symbols.meaning: The computed approximation of the normalized digit convolution $\varpi$.
symbols.quote: Multiplying by $S$ gives $\tilde\varpi$, which approximates $\varpi$ with error $E_{\varpi}=S(3E_s+2)$ units.

symbols.name: construction constant
symbols.meaning: The construction constant of the source, $2d\alpha^2$.
symbols.quote: Here $\gamma=2d\alpha^2$ is the construction constant of the source, where $d=\lfloor b^{\epsilon}\rfloor$ is the number of axes and $\alpha=\lceil(12d^2b)^{1/4}\rceil$.

symbols.name: number of axes
symbols.meaning: The number of axes of the padded box, equal to $\lfloor b^{\epsilon}\rfloor$.
symbols.quote: Here $\gamma=2d\alpha^2$ is the construction constant of the source, where $d=\lfloor b^{\epsilon}\rfloor$ is the number of axes and $\alpha=\lceil(12d^2b)^{1/4}\rceil$.

symbols.name: construction factor
symbols.meaning: The ceiling of $(12d^2b)^{1/4}$, the parameter $\alpha$ in the constant $\gamma$.
symbols.quote: Here $\gamma=2d\alpha^2$ is the construction constant of the source, where $d=\lfloor b^{\epsilon}\rfloor$ is the number of axes and $\alpha=\lceil(12d^2b)^{1/4}\rceil$.

symbols.name: normalized digit convolution
symbols.meaning: The convolution of the two scaled digit arrays divided by $S$.
symbols.quote: Let $\varpi=(\sigma\delta\ast\sigma\delta')/S$ be the normalized digit convolution.

symbols.name: paper's digit convolution
symbols.meaning: The paper's name for the normalized digit convolution $\varpi$.

relations.quote: This step bounds the error of the [Convolution over the polynomial ring](polynomial-ring-convolution.md), which is computed by two forward synthetic transforms, a pointwise product and an opposite transform.
This analysis takes its guard widths from the [Guard-width bound](guard-width-bound.md), so every intermediate value is exact.
This analysis bounds the error of the [Phase twist](phase-twist.md) at each end by $4h_p$.
The analysis keeps every operand within the [Array norm](array-norm.md) bound of one.
This analysis handles each product as a [bilinear map](bilinear-map.md) $\mathcal{B}$ of approximate operands $f'$ and $g'$, which approximate $f$ and $g$.
The stage bound includes the error of the [Opposite transform](opposite-transform.md), which adds $E_s$ units.
The error analysis bounds the error over the $T$ entries of the [Padded transform box](padded-transform-box.md).
This analysis takes its scale from the [Prime source lengths](prime-source-lengths.md), whose product is $S$.
This uses the growth rule of [Little-o notation](little-o-notation.md) to conclude $\gamma=o(b)$, since $1/2+2\epsilon<1$.

The final scaling undoes the normalizations of the [Normalization scales](normalization-scales.md): $2^{2b+4}$ reverses the two digit scales ($\sigma^2=2^{-2b-4}$), and $S$ reverses the division by $S$.
Each scaling is exact on the integer [Grid numerator](grid-numerator.md) of each value, so it adds no error.
Thus the analysis keeps every entry in the [closed disk in the complex plane](complex-disk.md) of radius one.
